multisite_reverse_ctmc.description: Sampling the reverse CTMC of a uniform-noise discrete diffusion model on X = [15]^10 under a fixed budget of intensity evaluations (NFE). The evaluator owns analytic held-out data distributions, answers intensity requests exactly, counts NFE, and scores the returned samples against the exact target on site marginals, site-pair marginals and the exact log-likelihood profile, at budgets 8, 16, 32 and 64 NFE.
multisite_reverse_ctmc.notes: Scaled extension of the paper's Section 6.1 / Appendix D.1 analytic toy (15 states per site, Q = E/15 - I per site, T = 12, arithmetic time grid, theta = 1/2, targets drawn uniformly from the simplex) from one site to ten sites, so that the joint state space (15^10) cannot be enumerated and a single intensity call no longer reveals the whole target. The paper's matched-NFE comparison (Sections 6.2-6.4) is the scoring regime. The paper reports Figure 2 slopes on the one-site toy over 16-1024 steps with 10^6 samples (theta-Trapezoidal 1.937, theta-RK-2 1.543, last four points 1.819); the gym's convergence_order is a pre-asymptotic fit over NFE 8-64 on multi-site pair marginals and is not on that scale, so those slopes are kept under _paper_reported. The convergence_order entries below record the paper's stated approximately second-order claim and are unchanged from earlier iterations.

_paper_reported.setting: one 15-state site, target uniform on the simplex, 10^6 samples, steps 16-1024, KL(p0 || q_hat)

log10_pair_kl_nfe8.description: log10 of the mean over all 45 site pairs of KL(p0 || q_hat) on the 225-cell pair marginal, geometric mean over held-out instances, at 8 intensity evaluations per sample.

log10_pair_kl_nfe16.description: As log10_pair_kl_nfe8, at 16 intensity evaluations per sample.

log10_pair_kl_nfe32.description: As log10_pair_kl_nfe8, at 32 intensity evaluations per sample.

log10_pair_kl_nfe64.description: As log10_pair_kl_nfe8, at 64 intensity evaluations per sample.

log10_loglik_kl_mean.description: log10 of KL(p0 || q_hat) on 50 equal-mass bins of the exact data log-likelihood log p0(x), averaged over instances and budgets. Sensitive to errors in the full joint configuration that pair marginals can miss.

log10_site_kl_mean.description: log10 of the mean single-site KL(p0 || q_hat) (the paper's one-site quantity), averaged over instances and budgets.

convergence_order.description: Negative log-log slope of the instance-geometric-mean pair KL against NFE (8-64), after removing the first-order finite-sample floor (224 / 2n).
